title: How John Rush runs 20+ bootstrapped startups with AI agents, no employees, no VC
summary: John Rush explains his problem-first, solo-founder model: solve your own problem, pitch ideas on Twitter before building, automate everything repetitive with AI agents, and keep each product small enough to run without a team. He also covers high-effort content and brutal self-criticism as growth habits.

principles.text: Build to solve your own problem first, not to make money; it's hard to fail when you and your friends are the first users.
principles.quote: I just see a problem in my own work and I want to solve the problem and then I solve the problem for myself first and for my friends

principles.text: Pitch ideas publicly before building them: it's free validation, free help and free distribution.
principles.quote: I can actually pitch my ideas before I build them. It means that I don't even have to raise money like this way. I pitch the idea that's free.

principles.text: Improve what users already like instead of piling on features; more features can complicate a product people chose for its simplicity.
principles.quote: I rather improve stuff I have because I believe that users want this stuff to be great rather than to stuff to have a lot of features

principles.text: Automate everything repetitive so the founder only does ideas, strategy and creative work.
principles.quote: I think we will automate everything so much that the only thing that will be left to do for founders is to invent ideas.

principles.text: Cap each product below $1M MRR so the portfolio stays runnable solo without a team or stress.
principles.quote: They have to be all below 1 million um MR and then as long as they are each below 1 million MR then I can still run it without stress

principles.text: High-effort content wins; do the work for your audience for free so they'd have paid for it.
principles.quote: high effort content will win no matter what because people feel that like it it's a when you read something and you see somebody spend time doing that it means they save your time
